_comment: Kibale NP — which linked models are quantified, and which are multiplied by their instance count. Schema verified against StingTools/BOQ/BOQCostManager.cs:344-350 (LinksConfig). Titles must match the linked Document.Title EXACTLY — that is the .rvt file name without the extension.
_critical: COT01 is set to multiply:true because it is placed SEVEN times. Without it, BOQCostManager.cs:3251 de-duplicates by model title and takes the cottage off exactly ONCE — six of your seven cottages would be free and nothing would warn you. See gap A-3.
_how_it_works: When multiply is true, Quantity, EmbodiedCarbonKg and BiogenicKg are each scaled by the number of LOADED link instances of that title, and the row is tagged '[Linked: <title> x7]'. Cost derives from Quantity so it scales automatically. The multiplier is applied AFTER the per-link takeoff cache, so changing it takes effect on the next BOQRefresh without re-walking the linked models.
_safer_route: Rather than hand-editing this file, set it through the UI: BOQ Cost Manager panel -> 'Linked models in takeoff'. Tick the links to include; if a link is placed more than once a SECOND picker appears offering the xN opt-in. The UI writes this exact file (UI/BOQCostManagerPanel.cs:670-708) and cannot get the titles wrong.
_also_know: Linked rows are READ-ONLY. They are not cost-stamped, so no CST_* parameters are written back into the cottage model, and you cannot select the element in the host from the BOQ row. Cost write-back happens only in the host model.
